content: Reyansh Tiwari contacted insurance agent Ramesh Tiwari expressing shock over his health policy (HP-123456) expiring on the 10th without receiving renewal reminders. Ramesh Tiwari apologized for the oversight, confirmed the expiration due to non-payment, and provided an invoice with instructions to pay the outstanding premium and a reinstatement fee to restore the policy.

action_items: Pay the outstanding premium and reinstatement fee to renew policy HP-123456
